verdicts.reason: A has an arbitrary layout: the headline is pushed in to x≈117 while the button sits about 82px from the right edge, so the margins don't match and there is a dead gap in the middle. The upscaled button also has jagged, pixelated edges and the text sits above vertical centre. B anchors the headline at the left edge like the original, but its button still floats about 79px from the right edge against a 22px left margin, and the button edges are just as jagged.

A keeps the original's edge-anchored banner structure with near-matching margins (about 26px left, 34px right) and both elements vertically centred. Only the slightly aliased edge on the button pill needs polish. B is the same lopsided version as pair 1A: the headline is indented about 117px for no reason, the button floats short of the right edge, the button edges are pixelated and the text sits high.

A centres the headline and button as one symmetric group, which reads as deliberate. It drops the original's split from edge to edge, though, and leaves wide empty flanks on a 768px banner, and the button edges are slightly jagged. B is again the lopsided layout with an arbitrary 117px headline indent, mismatched margins, a pixelated button and text sitting above centre.
